spotlightStoryMetadata.llmDescription: A behind-the-scenes look at the FENDI Roma collection runway show. See models walk the colorful catwalk, showcasing avant-garde pieces like floral prints, geometric knits, and a stunning pink organza finale dress. Hear from the designer about her inspiration for gentle, soft silhouettes and unique accessories.
